faq.title:
Everything else
you’re wondering.
faq.description: A closer look at TripleP and where we’re heading.
faq.items.0.question: What is TripleP?
faq.items.0.answer: TripleP is a web task manager inspired by Jira and ClickUp. It brings projects, priorities, and people into a shared workspace.
faq.items.1.question: Who is it for?
faq.items.1.answer: TripleP is being built for people and teams who want a clearer way to organize projects and discuss their work.
faq.items.2.question: Is the workspace preview a live project?
faq.items.2.answer: No. The preview is a visual illustration of the product direction. It does not display a real team’s projects or tasks.
faq.items.3.question: Can I start using TripleP today?
faq.items.3.answer: The product is currently in development. This page introduces the direction of the workspace; account creation is not available here yet.
faq.items.4.question: Where can I see pricing and integrations?
faq.items.4.answer: Confirmed plans and supported integrations will be shared when those product details are available.
faq.items.5.question: Can I view this page in another language?
faq.items.5.answer: Yes. Use the language selector in the navigation to switch between English and Russian. Your preference is remembered in this browser.
